issuer: the Michigan Department of State (Secretary of State)
note: Michigan Compiled Laws on legislature.mi.gov (read 2026-10-30): MCL 257.811 charges $25 for an original operator's licence ($18 to renew); MCL 257.314 has it expire on the birthday in the fourth year after issue (4 years; a first licence got before 20½ expires at 21); MCL 257.310e graduated licensing gives level 3 (full) status from 17, so a full licence is kept from 17. MCL 28.292 charges $10 for an original or renewed state personal identification card, expiring on the birthday in the fourth year after issue (4 years); no age is held for it.

sources.title: MCL 257.811, Fees for operator's license
sources.said: Operator's license $ 25.00 ... The renewal fee for an operator's license renewed under this section is $18.00.

sources.title: MCL 257.314, Expiration of license
sources.said: an operator's license and chauffeur's license expire on the birthday of the individual to whom the license is issued in the fourth year following the date of the issuance of the license

sources.title: MCL 257.310e, Graduated licensing
sources.said: (9) A person who is not less than 17 years of age may be issued a level 3 graduated licensing status

sources.title: MCL 28.292, Official state personal identification card
sources.said: an applicant shall pay a fee of $10.00 to the secretary of state for each original or renewal official state personal identification card issued. ... (13) An original or renewal official state personal identification card expires on the birthday of the individual to whom it is issued in the fourth year following the date of issuance
